evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Quinton commits the org to a monthly cadence by positional authority (legitimate) and frames the value of rehearsal as existential readiness — an appeal to a shared principle, not a threat or reward.
The note-taker supplies and controls the factual record of what was decided and who owns it — informational power exercised through summary, not an influence attempt on the reader.

mints.name: RehearsalAsReadinessMandate
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.theme: Authority commits a recurring practice by framing unrehearsed contingencies as nonexistent capabilities, turning a cadence decision into an existential readiness claim.
